args.sql:
SELECT 
    matchidx,
    COUNT(*) as total_stops,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) as unique_cars,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS numeric) / COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) as avg_stops
FROM pit_stops
GROUP BY matchidx
ORDER BY matchidx
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) as single_stop_race_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        matchidx,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS numeric) / COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) as avg_stops
    FROM pit_stops
    GROUP BY matchidx
    HAVING CAST(COUNT(*) AS numeric) / COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) < 1.5
) sub;
